verse.verse_1: By those who range themselves in rows;
verse.verse_3: and those who recite the Exhortation;
verse.verse_5: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and of whatever lies between the two, the Lord of the Easts.
verse.verse_6: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars
verse.verse_7: and have protected it from every rebellious satan.
verse.verse_8: These satans cannot listen to what transpires in the High Council for they are pelted away from every side
verse.verse_9: and are repelled. Theirs is an unceasing chastisement.
verse.verse_10: And if any is able to snatch a fragment, he is pursued by a piercing flame.
verse.verse_11: So ask them (that is, human beings): “Were they harder to create than the objects We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
verse.verse_12: You marvel (at the wondrous creations of Allah) and they scoff at it,
verse.verse_13: and when they are admonished, they pay no heed;
verse.verse_14: and if they see any Sign, they laugh it away
verse.verse_15: and say: “This is nothing but plain sorcery.
verse.verse_16: Is it ever possible that after we die and are reduced to dust and (a skeleton of) bones, we will be raised to life?
verse.verse_17: And so also shall our forefathers of yore be raised to life?”
verse.verse_18: Tell them: “Yes; and you are utterly helpless (against Allah).”
verse.verse_19: There will be a single stern rebuff and lo, they will be observing with their own eyes (all that they had been warned against).
verse.verse_20: They will then say: “Woe for us. This is the Day of Judgement.”
verse.verse_21: “Yes, this is the Day of Final Decision that you used to deny as a lie.”
verse.verse_22: (Then will the command be given): “Muster all the wrong-doers and their spouses and the deities whom they used to serve
verse.verse_23: apart from Allah, and direct them to the path of Hell,
verse.verse_24: and detain them there; they will be called to account.
verse.verse_25: How is it that you are not helping one another?
verse.verse_26: Indeed, today they are surrendering themselves completely.”
verse.verse_27: They will then turn towards each other (and start wrangling).
verse.verse_28: (The followers will say to their leaders): “You used to come to us from the right hand.”
verse.verse_29: They will say: “Nay, you yourselves were not the ones who would believe.
verse.verse_30: We had no power over you. You were a rebellious people,
verse.verse_31: and so we became deserving of the Word of our Lord that we shall be made to suffer chastisement.
verse.verse_32: So we led you astray; we ourselves were strayed.”
verse.verse_33: On that Day, they will all share the chastisement.
verse.verse_34: Thus do We treat the culprits.
verse.verse_35: Whenever it was said to them: “There is no true deity apart from Allah,” they waxed proud
verse.verse_36: and said: “Shall we forsake our deities for the sake of a distracted poet?”
verse.verse_37: (They say so although) he brought the Truth and confirmed the veracity of the Messengers.
verse.verse_38: (They will be told): “You shall taste the grievous chastisement.
verse.verse_39: You will only be recompensed according to your deeds.”
verse.verse_40: But Allah's chosen servants (shall be spared this woeful end).
verse.verse_41: For them awaits a known provision,
verse.verse_42: a variety of delicious fruits; and they shall be honoured
verse.verse_44: They will be seated upon couches set face to face;
verse.verse_45: a cup filled with wine from its springs, will be passed around to them;
verse.verse_46: white, sparkling (wine), a delight to the drinkers.
verse.verse_47: There will neither be any harm in it for their body nor will it intoxicate their mind.
verse.verse_48: Theirs shall be wide-eyed maidens with bashful, restrained glances,
verse.verse_49: so delicate as the hidden peel under an egg's shell.
verse.verse_50: Then some of them will turn to others, and will ask each other.
verse.verse_51: One of them will say: “I had a companion in the world
verse.verse_52: who used to say: -- Are you also one of those who confirm the Truth (of life after death)?
verse.verse_53: After we are dead and have become all dust and bones shall we still be requited?'
verse.verse_54: He will say: -- Do you wish to know where he is now?'
verse.verse_55: Then he will look downwards, and will see him in the depths of Hell.
verse.verse_56: He will say to him: -- By Allah, you almost ruined me.
verse.verse_57: But for Allah's favour, I should be one of those who have been mustered here.
verse.verse_58: So, are we not going to die,
verse.verse_59: except for our first death? And shall we suffer no chastisement?'”
verse.verse_60: Surely this is the supreme triumph.
verse.verse_61: For the like of it should the workers work.
verse.verse_62: Is this a better hospitality or the tree of al-Zaqqum?
verse.verse_63: We have made this tree a trial for the wrong-doers.
verse.verse_64: It is a tree that grows in the nethermost part of Hell.
verse.verse_65: Its spathes are like the heads of satans.
verse.verse_66: (The people of Hell) will surely eat of it, filling their bellies with it.
verse.verse_67: Then on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water.
verse.verse_68: Then their return will be to the same blazing Hell.
verse.verse_69: These are the ones who found their fathers steeped in error,
verse.verse_70: and they are running in their footsteps.
verse.verse_71: Before them a multitude of people of olden times had erred,
verse.verse_72: and We had sent among them Messengers to warn them.
verse.verse_73: Observe, then, what was the end of those that had been warned,
verse.verse_74: except for the chosen servants of Allah?
verse.verse_75: Noah had called upon Us (earlier). See, how excellent We were in answering him!
verse.verse_76: We delivered him and his household from the great calamity;
verse.verse_77: and made his offspring the only ones to survive,
verse.verse_78: and We established for him a good name among posterity.
verse.verse_79: Peace be upon Noah among all the nations.
verse.verse_80: Thus do We reward all those who do good.
verse.verse_81: Surely he was one of Our truly believing servants.
verse.verse_82: Thereafter We caused the others to be drowned.
verse.verse_83: Abraham was on the self-same way (as Noah).
verse.verse_84: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart,
verse.verse_85: and said to his father and his people: “Whom do you worship?
verse.verse_86: Is it false deities that you want to serve rather than Allah?
verse.verse_87: What do you think of the Lord of the whole Universe?”
verse.verse_88: Then he looked carefully at the stars
verse.verse_90: So turning their backs, they went away from him.
verse.verse_91: Then he went quietly to the (temple of the deities) and said: “What is the matter with you, why do you not eat?
verse.verse_92: What is the matter with you, why do you not speak?”
verse.verse_93: Then he turned upon them, striking them with his right hand,
verse.verse_94: whereupon people came to him running.
verse.verse_95: Abraham said to them: “Do you worship what you yourselves have carved with your own hands
verse.verse_96: while it is Allah Who has created you and all that you make?”
verse.verse_97: They spoke among themselves: “Build him a pyre and then throw him into the furnace.”
verse.verse_98: They had contrived an evil plan against him, but We abased them all.
verse.verse_99: Abraham said: “I am going to my Lord; He will guide me.
verse.verse_100: Lord, grant me a righteous son.”
verse.verse_101: (In response to this prayer) We gave him the good news of a prudent boy;
verse.verse_102: and when he was old enough to go about and work with him, (one day) Abraham said to him: “My son, I see in my dream that I am slaughtering you. So consider (and tell me) what you think.” He said: “Do as you are bidden. You will find me, if Allah so wills, among the steadfast.”
verse.verse_103: When both surrendered (to Allah's command) and Abraham flung the son down on his forehead,
verse.verse_105: you have indeed fulfilled your dream. Thus do We reward the good-doers.”
verse.verse_106: This was indeed a plain trial.
verse.verse_107: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,
verse.verse_108: and We preserved for him a good name among posterity.
verse.verse_110: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verse.verse_111: Surely he was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_112: And We gave him the good news of Isaac, a Prophet and among the righteous ones.
verse.verse_113: And We blessed him and Isaac. Among the offspring of the two some did good and some plainly wronged themselves.
verse.verse_114: Verily We bestowed Our favours on Moses and Aaron
verse.verse_115: and We delivered both of them and their people from the great calamity.
verse.verse_116: We succoured them, and they gained the upper hand (against their enemies).
verse.verse_117: We granted them a Clear Book,
verse.verse_118: and showed them the Straight Way,
verse.verse_119: and preserved for them a good name among posterity.
verse.verse_120: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
verse.verse_121: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verse.verse_122: Surely both of them were among Our believing servants.
verse.verse_123: Surely, Elias too was among the Messengers.
verse.verse_124: (Call to mind) when he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allah?
verse.verse_125: Do you call upon Baal and forsake the Best of the Creators?
verse.verse_126: Allah is your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of yore.”
verse.verse_127: But they denounced him as a liar, so they will surely be arraigned (for punishment),
verse.verse_129: We preserved a good name for him among posterity.
verse.verse_131: Thus do We reward the good-doers.
verse.verse_132: He was one of Our believing servants.
verse.verse_133: And Lot too was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_134: (Call to mind) when We delivered him and all his kinsfolk,
verse.verse_135: except for an old woman who was among those that stayed behind.
verse.verse_136: Then We utterly destroyed the rest of them.
verse.verse_137: You pass by their desolate habitations in the morning
verse.verse_138: and at night. Do you still not understand?
verse.verse_139: And Jonah too was one of the Messengers.
verse.verse_140: Call to mind when he fled to the laden ship,
verse.verse_141: cast lots, and was among the losers.
verse.verse_142: Then a fish swallowed him, and he was blameworthy.
verse.verse_143: Had he not been one of those who glorify Allah,
verse.verse_144: he would certainly have remained in its belly till the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_145: But We threw him on a wide bare tract of land while he was ill;
verse.verse_146: and caused a gourd tree to grow over him,
verse.verse_147: and We sent him forth to a nation of a hundred thousand or more,
verse.verse_148: and they believed. So We let them enjoy life for a while.
verse.verse_149: So ask their opinion: “(Are you convinced) that your Lord should have daughters and you should have sons?
verse.verse_150: Did We create the angels as females the while they witnessed?”
verse.verse_151: Behold, it is one of their fabrications that they say:
verse.verse_153: Did He choose daughters rather than sons?
verse.verse_154: What is the matter with you that you make such strange judgements?
verse.verse_155: Will you then not take heed?
verse.verse_156: Do you have any clear authority for such claims?
verse.verse_157: Bring your Book, if you are truthful.
verse.verse_158: They have established a kinship between Allah and the angels; and the angels know well that these people will be arraigned (as culprits).
verse.verse_159: (They say): “Exalted be Allah above what they attribute to Him,
verse.verse_160: all of them except the chosen servants of Allah.
verse.verse_162: shall not be able to tempt anyone away from Allah
verse.verse_163: except him who shall roast in the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_164: As for us, there is none but has an appointed station.
verse.verse_165: Verily we range ourselves in rows (as humble servants)
verse.verse_166: and we are of those who glorify Allah.”
verse.verse_168: “If only we had the Reminder which had been granted to the people of yore
verse.verse_169: we would surely have been Allah's chosen servants.”
verse.verse_170: But when it came to them, they rejected it. They shall soon come to know (the end of such an attitude).
verse.verse_171: We have already given Our promise to Our Messengers
verse.verse_172: that they shall certainly be succoured,
verse.verse_173: and that Our hosts shall triumph.
verse.verse_174: So, (O Prophet), leave them alone for a while,
verse.verse_175: and see, and soon they too shall see.
verse.verse_176: Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?
verse.verse_177: When that chastisement will descend upon their courtyard, evil shall that Day be for those who had been warned.
verse.verse_178: Leave them alone for a while,
verse.verse_179: and see; and they too shall soon see.
verse.verse_180: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, above what they attribute to Him,
verse.verse_181: and peace be upon the Messengers,
verse.verse_182: and all praise be to Allah, the Lord of the Universe.
